title: 第二十二章离别求推荐第二十一章两女相见
content_zh:
第二十二章离别
飞燕寨因为陈林不断的建议，飞速的壮大着，特别是陈林将功法拿出来，让顾飞燕很吃惊，要知道在诸神大陆，对功法可是很重视的，那怕是低级的功法也不会送给平民的。
这其实也就是贵族和国家，维护自己的地位的一种措施。陈林这样做无疑是打破了这个规矩，将自己家族的功法无偿的，送个飞燕寨的普通人。
作为忠于陈家的张硕，对于陈林的做法很反对，不过在陈林的解释下，也就接受了。用陈林的话说就是，这些低级功法和法术，在陈家一定用也没有，但是给这些人后他们会因为感激自己，而为自己效力，帮助自己就是帮助陈家。
在陈林这些优厚的条件下，飞燕寨每天都在不断的变化中，现在正个山寨扩大了十几倍，占领了好几个山峰做为营地，而且在山下开了近千亩的荒地，让那些流民都有地种有房子住。
飞燕寨这段时间的变化，大家都看在眼里，这里头最高兴的就数顾飞燕，飞燕寨本来就是她建立的，现在看着飞燕寨发展的这么好，心里当然很高心。而且这些都还是自己心上人的功劳，她心中更是欢喜。
其实在陈林帮助燕儿提示天赋后，她就知道陈林绝非池中之物，而且也不可能只有她一个女人，所以高傲的她才会接受陈林有别的女人，为了不让陈林为次烦恼，燕儿更是和翠儿打好关系，并且达成一致，看住陈林不让他在勾引别的女人。
不过陈林注定是不可能永远呆在这里的，虽然这里是一个很好的势力，但是却不是陈林唯一要的势力，陈林注定不会平凡，他的舞台是整个大陆，不可能只待在飞燕寨。
燕儿自己也知道这一点，所以在陈林在飞燕寨的这段时间里，每天都陪着陈林，晚上更是和陈林每天都疯狂到深夜，那怕陈林晚上是赔翠儿，她也会等着翠儿睡着后，再和陈林一直激战到天明。
也幸亏陈林的体质好，要不然被得被顾飞燕的疯狂榨干不可，不过陈林也对于燕儿的主动很享受，特别是在赔翠儿时和她偷情般的刺激，更是让陈林激动不已。
不过陈林也知道燕儿之所以这样，是因为自己要走了。陈林在飞燕寨已经呆了一个多月了，而且这里的发展也进入了正规，陈林的领地方面也需要他去接手。
陈林走是必然的，只是因为感觉到了燕儿的不舍，所以陈林一直没有下定决心走，他也舍不得燕儿一个人留在这里，只不过飞燕寨还需要一个人在这里压阵，要不然刚刚成型的基业，就会瞬间泯灭。
这几天陈林每天也没什么事，几乎所有的时间都陪着燕儿，两个人就这样腻在一起，唧唧我我。也许是感觉到离别的时候越来越近，所以燕儿特别的主动，经常还是白天的时候，就开始挑逗陈林。就这样两人过着没日没夜，没羞没臊的日子。
有还几次翠儿过来叫陈林吃饭，正好撞见了两人正在疯狂的交.合。羞得翠儿转身就跑，嘴里不断嘀咕着“大白天的就这样，没羞没臊！”
不过陈林每次见到翠儿来，都会忍不住的幻想“要是燕儿和翠儿一起我们三人，那该有多好……”
这一天陈林和燕儿正在一起，吃着瓜子喝茶聊天，燕儿突然说了一句“你是不是像我们姐妹两人一起伺候你啊！”
陈林正喝着茶呢，听燕儿这么说顿时被茶呛到了。“咳咳咳~……胡说八道些什么啊，我可是很正经的。”
“真的吗！”燕儿看着陈林故作正经的样子，于是接着又调笑道“那正是可惜了，我本来还想帮帮你的，既然你不想，那就算了吧！”
“啊，啊别啊，燕儿你，你真的愿意三个人……”陈林顿时上钩。
“哼，就知道你是不正经！大色狼，变态，死变态！”

陈林顿时坏笑道“嘿嘿，方正都是我的女人，在一起也没什么关系嘛！”
“哼，要不是你快走了，我才不愿意呢！”说着燕儿顿时有种离别的伤感。
陈林看见燕儿有点伤感的样子，赶紧将她抱在腿上安慰起来，“燕儿，不要伤心了，我的领地离你这里很近的，只有一天的路程，而且我有不是不回来了，我会随时回来看你的！不要想太多了，这只是暂时的。”
就在陈林抱着燕儿安慰的时候，翠儿进来了，见到陈林抱着燕儿，顿时羞红了脸低头着头轻说道“大白天的，你们俩也注意一下啊！”
燕儿却是笑嘻嘻的站起来回道“妹妹又不是旁人，看见了也没什么啊，而且更劲爆的你也见过了，怕什么啊！”
翠儿被顾飞燕这么一说，顿时就想起了前几天他们两人交.合的场面。顿时脸色羞的通红“羞死了，姐姐你还好意思说，大白天的额你们就，就……”
“就怎么样啊？”听见翠儿不好意思说，燕儿接着逗着她。“见都见过了，还有什么不好意思说的。”

Chapter 22 Farewell
Feiyan Village grew rapidly because of Chen Lin's constant suggestions, especially when Chen Lin took out the exercises, which surprised Gu Feiyan. You must know that in the Continent of the Gods, they attach great importance to exercises, and even low-level exercises will not be given to civilians.
This is actually a measure for the nobles and the country to maintain their status. By doing this, Chen Lin undoubtedly broke this rule and gave his family's skills to ordinary people in Feiyan Village for free.
Zhang Shuo, who was loyal to the Chen family, was very opposed to Chen Lin's approach, but after Chen Lin's explanation, he accepted it. In Chen Lin's words, these low-level techniques and spells are definitely useless in the Chen family, but after being given to these people, they will work for him out of gratitude to him. Helping him is helping the Chen family.
Under Chen Lin's favorable conditions, Feiyan Village is constantly changing every day. Now the village has expanded more than ten times, occupying several peaks as camps, and opening up nearly a thousand acres of wasteland at the foot of the mountain, allowing the refugees to have land and houses to live in.
Everyone has seen the changes in Feiyan Village during this period. The happiest person here is Gu Feiyan. She was the one who established Feiyan Village. Now seeing Feiyan Village developing so well, she is of course very happy. And these were all the work of her sweetheart, and she was even more happy.
In fact, after Chen Lin helped Yan'er to remind her of her talent, she knew that Chen Lin was definitely not the one in the pool, and she couldn't be the only woman, so she was so proud that she would accept that Chen Lin had another woman. In order to prevent Chen Lin from worrying about this, Yan'er even established a good relationship with Cui'er and reached an agreement to keep Chen Lin from seducing other women.
However, Chen Lin is destined not to stay here forever. Although this is a good force, it is not the only force that Chen Lin wants. Chen Lin is destined to be extraordinary. His stage is the entire continent, and he cannot just stay in Feiyan Village.
Yan'er herself knew this, so she stayed with Chen Lin every day during Chen Lin's stay in Feiyan Village, and even went crazy with Chen Lin until late at night every night. Even if Chen Lin had to apologize to Cui'er at night, she would wait for Cui'er to fall asleep, and then keep fighting with Chen Lin until dawn.
Fortunately, Chen Lin had a good physique, otherwise he would have been squeezed dry by Gu Feiyan's craziness. However, Chen Lin also enjoyed Yan'er's initiative, especially the excitement of having an affair with her when he compensated Cui'er, which made Chen Lin extremely excited.
But Chen Lin also knew that the reason why Yan'er was like this was because he was leaving. Chen Lin has been staying in Feiyan Village for more than a month, and the development here has also entered a formal stage. Chen Lin also needs him to take over the territory.
It was inevitable for Chen Lin to leave, but because he felt Yan'er's reluctance, Chen Lin never made up his mind to leave. He also couldn't bear to leave Yan'er alone. However, Feiyan Village still needs one person to hold the battle here, otherwise the newly formed foundation will be wiped out in an instant.
Chen Lin had nothing to do these days. He spent almost all the time with Yan'er. The two of them just got tired of being together, chirping at each other. Perhaps because she felt that the time of separation was getting closer, Yan'er took the initiative and often started teasing Chen Lin during the day. In this way, the two of them lived day and night without shame.
There were several times when Cui'er came over to ask Chen Lin to eat, and happened to catch the two of them having sex wildly. She was so embarrassed that Cui'er turned around and ran away, muttering constantly, "That's how it is in broad daylight, no shame at all!"
But every time Chen Lin sees Cui'er coming, he can't help but fantasize, "How great would it be if Yan'er and Cui'er were the three of us together..."
On this day, Chen Lin and Yan'er were together, eating melon seeds, drinking tea and chatting. Yan'er suddenly said, "Are you like us two sisters serving you together?"
Chen Lin was drinking tea, and when he heard what Yan'er said, he was immediatelyI choked on my tea. "Ahem, cough, cough~...what are you talking about? I'm very serious."
"Really!" Yan'er looked at Chen Lin's pretending to be serious, so she joked, "That's a pity. I originally wanted to help you, but since you don't want to, forget it!"
"Ah, ah no, Yan'er, are you really willing to have three people..." Chen Lin immediately took the bait.
"Hmph, I knew you weren't serious! You're a big pervert, a pervert, a real pervert!"
Chen Lin immediately smiled evilly and said, "Hey, Fangzheng is my woman, so it doesn't matter if we are together!"
"Huh, if you weren't leaving soon, I wouldn't want to!" Yan'er suddenly felt sad about parting as she said this.
Chen Lin saw Yan'er looking a little sad and quickly held her on his lap to comfort her, "Yan'er, don't be sad. My territory is very close to you, only a day's journey away. And if I don't come back, I will come back to see you at any time! Don't think too much, this is only temporary."
Just when Chen Lin was holding Yan'er to comfort her, Cui'er came in. When she saw Chen Lin holding Yan'er, she blushed and lowered her head and said softly, "It's broad daylight, you two should pay attention!"
Yan'er stood up with a smile and replied, "My sister is not a stranger, so it's okay if she sees it. And you've seen the more exciting ones, so what are you afraid of!"
When Gu Feiyan said this, Cui'er immediately remembered the scene where the two of them had sex a few days ago. His face suddenly turned red with embarrassment, "I'm so embarrassed, sister, you still have the nerve to say that, in broad daylight, you guys just..."
"That's it?" Hearing Cui'er say embarrassedly, Yan'er continued to tease her. "I've seen it all before. Is there anything else I'm embarrassed to say?"
